item.title: Florida couple spent 41 years preserving a 1908 house; it is now a local historic landmark
item.description: In Oneco, Florida, the Johnson Helm House has earned the title of the first local historic landmark in the county. Built in 1908, this charming residence has been lovingly preserved by Margi and Pat Nanney for over four decades, keeping its unique architectural attributes intact. Their commitment has prevented modern alterations from obscuring its character, while this recognition emphasizes the area's important agricultural history. Fuente: The Times of India - World.
